name: Regal Summit
archetypes: High Card, Kingmaker, Contract Attacker; splash Spade Master
decision: None directly; the hand bids as if each king were an ace.
opponent: Visible when a king plays as an ace; opponents can still trump it or play a natural ace after it to win the tie.
aiNote: Count each king as an ace when bidding and when judging whether a lead is safe.
rationale: The smallest possible change does the whole job: a king becomes an ace, so Unclouded Sun (DU-S01) and win payoffs that name aces treat it as one; it checks a card's rank before it applies, so it never chains a queen upward.
